title: Integer slice property of IM currents with IM boundary (V4(i))
statement: Assume (IMC), (SL), (MM) and (RU). (IMC) is the exact frozen statement of cmc_imRep_locality_restrict_sub: (a) locality of approximate tangent spaces for nested Borel sets, (b) for every IMRep R in an open U and Borel E there are a current A and an IMRep R' representing A with carrier R.carrier ∩ E, multiplicity R.mult and orientation R.orient, (c) for open U, differences of integer multiplicity currents in 𝒟_n(U) are integer multiplicity, (d) IMRep orientations satisfy |orient(x)(α)| ≤ |α| for Hⁿ⌞carrier-a.e. x and all α. (SL) is the exact frozen statement of cmc_slice_mass_bounds: for open U, T ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(U) represented by (μ, ξ) and ∂T by (μ', ξ') (measures finite on compact subsets of U, a.e. strongly measurable fields, a.e. bounded by 1 in the coefficient norm) and L-Lipschitz f, there are currents A_t ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(U), B_t ∈ 𝒟_k(U) (t ∈ ℝ) with A_t(ω) = ∫_{f<t}ξ(ω)dμ, B_t(η) = ∫_{f<t}ξ'(η)dμ', ∂A_t = B_t on forms supported off {f = t}, M_W(∂A_t − B_t) ≤ L·liminf_{h↓0} h⁻¹μ(W ∩ {t−h<f<t}) for open W, and ∫_{(a,b)} M_W(∂A_t − B_t) dt ≤ L·μ(W ∩ {a<f<b}). (MM) is the third conjunct of the frozen statement of the sibling cbr_measure_convergence_tools: for Borel measures μ_j on ℝ^P, continuous f, G ⊆ ℝ^P, a, b ∈ ℝ, L ≥ 0 with μ_j(G ∩ {a<f<b}) < ∞ and Z_j : ℝ → [0,∞] with Z_j(t) ≤ L·liminf_{h↓0} h⁻¹μ_j(G ∩ {t−h<f<t}) for all j and t ∈ (a,b), there is a measurable g : ℝ → [0,∞] with liminf_j Z_j(t) ≤ g(t) for L¹-a.e. t ∈ (a,b) and ∫_{(a,b)} g ≤ L·liminf_j μ_j(G ∩ {a<f<b}). (RU) is the frozen statement of the sibling cbr_setIntegral_eq_of_integral_eq: if, in an open U ⊆ ℝ^P, three pairs (μ_i, ξ_i) (Borel measures finite on compact subsets of U, a.e. strongly measurable k-vector fields with |ξ_i(x)(α)| ≤ |α| a.e.) satisfy ∫ξ₁(ω)dμ₁ = ∫ξ₂(ω)dμ₂ + ∫ξ₃(ω)dμ₃ for every ω ∈ 𝒟^k(U), then ∫_Bξ₁(ω)dμ₁ = ∫_Bξ₂(ω)dμ₂ + ∫_Bξ₃(ω)dμ₃ for every Borel B and every ω ∈ 𝒟^k(U). Let d ∈ ℕ and assume BR(d): for all P, every open U ⊆ ℝ^P and every integer multiplicity R ∈ 𝒟_{d+1}(U) with M_W(∂R) < ∞ for every open W with compact closure in U, ∂R is integer multiplicity. Then for every P ∈ ℕ, every integer multiplicity X ∈ 𝒟_{d+1}(ℝ^P) whose boundary ∂X ∈ 𝒟_d(ℝ^P) is integer multiplicity has the integer slice property. Here a current X ∈ 𝒟_{d+1}(ℝ^P) has the integer slice property (ISP) if for all admissible representations (μ, ξ) of X and (μ', ξ') of ∂X in ℝ^P (Borel measures finite on every compact set; a.e. strongly measurable fields of (d+1)- resp. d-vectors with |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| for a.e. x and every covector α, |·| the Euclidean coefficient norm covectorEuclideanNorm; X(ω) = ∫ξ(ω)dμ and ∂X(η) = ∫ξ'(η)dμ' for all test forms) and every Lipschitz f : ℝ^P → ℝ, for L¹-a.e. t ∈ ℝ, every pair A ∈ 𝒟_{d+1}(ℝ^P), B ∈ 𝒟_d(ℝ^P) with A(ω) = ∫_{f<t}ξ(ω)dμ and B(η) = ∫_{f<t}ξ'(η)dμ' for all test forms has ∂A − B integer multiplicity (the predicate written out verbatim in the frozen statements of the siblings cbr_slice_property_of_weak_limit and cbr_cycle_isIntegerMultiplicity).
